description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consultant \-Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P\&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power\-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 \- Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 \- Personal Insurance, AINS 23 \- Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 \- General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.
* We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Java Developer** 
 with at least
 **7 years of Java development experience** 
 and proven experience leading a team of Java developers. The role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering scalable Java\-based applications and systems for large enterprise environments. This position will translate business requirements into technical solutions, support high\-quality software delivery, resolve technical issues, and contribute to innovation through modern development practices, microservices architecture, and cloud computing.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**
* Java: At least 7 years of professional experience developing Java\-based applications and systems.
* Java Development Tools: Experience using standard Java development, testing, debugging, build, and deployment tools.
* Software Development Methodologies: Practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable iterative delivery methodologies.
* Application Development: Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise Java applications.
* Version Control and Collaboration Tools: Experience using organization\-approved source control, issue tracking, code review, and collaboration tools.
* Testing Tools: Experience developing and executing unit, integration, and functional tests for Java applications.
* Enterprise Delivery Practices: Experience delivering Java\-based solutions within a large enterprise environment.


****Preferred****
* Java SE 11 or later: Experience developing applications using Java 11 or a later supported version.
* Microservices Technologies: Experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications.
* Cloud Computing Platforms: Practical exposure to cloud\-based application development, deployment, or support.
* Java Frameworks: Experience with commonly used Java application frameworks and libraries relevant to enterprise development.
* Deployment and Automation Tools: Exposure to continuous integration, continuous delivery, containerization, or deployment automation tools.
* Java Development Certification: Advanced certification aligned with Java development, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Lead, coordinate, and mentor a team of Java developers while supporting effective collaboration, technical growth, and high\-quality delivery.
* Develop, enhance, maintain, test, and deploy Java\-based applications and systems that meet defined business and technical requirements.
* Design and implement scalable, efficient, maintainable, and supportable Java solutions for large enterprise environments.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, development tasks, implementation plans, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve technical issues, manage dependencies, and support informed engineering decisions.
* Apply software development methodologies, coding standards, testing practices, and documentation requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot application defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and production incidents within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to the adoption of microservices architecture, cloud computing, and other relevant technologies where they support business and operational objectives.
* Review technical designs, code, test results, and implementation plans to identify risks and improve solution quality.
* Promote maintainable solutions that use resources efficiently, reduce avoidable processing, and consider sustainability in application design and cloud usage where applicable.
* Track delivery progress, communicate risks and dependencies, and support continuous improvement across the development team.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* At least 7 years of professional experience with Java programming.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, exception handling, collections, concurrency, and application design principles.
* Experience developing, debugging, testing, and maintaining Java\-based enterprise applications.


****Preferred****
* Experience with Java 11 or later.
* Experience with scripting or additional programming languages used to support automation, integration, or application operations.


**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****
* Experience integrating Java applications with relational or enterprise data stores.
* Ability to work with application data models, queries, transactions, data validation, and persistence requirements.
* Experience troubleshooting application issues involving data access, consistency, or performance.


****Preferred****
* Experience with both relational and non\-relational databases.
* Familiarity with database performance optimization, indexing, transaction management, and data migration.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts relevant to application development, deployment, scalability, and support.
* Ability to contribute to Java application delivery in cloud\-based or hybrid environments.


****Preferred****
* Hands\-on experience deploying or supporting Java applications on cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerized applications, scalable services, monitoring, and resource optimization.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* Experience using Java frameworks and libraries to develop maintainable enterprise applications.
* Understanding of application layers, service components, dependency management, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Experience designing or supporting scalable application components.


****Preferred****
* Experience developing microservices\-based applications.
* Exposure to frameworks and libraries used for web applications, REST services, dependency injection, persistence, messaging, or distributed systems.
* Experience applying design patterns and principles that improve application maintainability and reuse.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with source control, code reviews, defect tracking, build management, testing, deployment, and technical documentation.
* Experience participating in requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, release, and post\-production support.
* Experience leading or coordinating development activities within a team.


****Preferred****
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Exposure to automated build, deployment, quality analysis, monitoring, and containerization tools.
* Experience working with iterative planning, estimation, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure software development practices for Java applications.
* Ability to apply appropriate authentication, authorization, input validation, secure error handling, and protection of sensitive data.
* Awareness of secure API communication, access controls, vulnerability management, and organizational security standards.


****Preferred****
* Experience implementing security controls in microservices or cloud\-based applications.
* Exposure to secure coding assessments, application security testing, encryption practices, and security reviews.


****Experience Requirements****
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development.
* Proven experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of Java developers.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering Java\-based applications and systems in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and guiding implementation through development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture and cloud computing is preferred.
* Experience resolving technical issues, supporting production applications, and meeting delivery timelines.
* Industry or domain experience relevant to the assigned business environment is preferred but not required unless specified for a particular project.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience demonstrating comparable Java development expertise, technical leadership, enterprise delivery, and successful implementation outcomes.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Lead and mentor a team of Java developers, assign or coordinate development activities, review technical work, and support delivery quality.
* Analyze business requirements, participate in design and planning discussions, and translate requirements into Java\-based technical solutions.
* Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Java applications while monitoring delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement new technologies, make decisions within approved technical standards, and deliver maintainable solutions within agreed timelines.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development, including experience delivering enterprise Java applications and systems.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring Java developers and coordinating technical delivery activities.
* Advanced Java development certification, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification, is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, technology learning, certification opportunities, and evolving software engineering practices.


**Professional Competencies**
* Apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to assess requirements, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and implement effective technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through mentoring, constructive feedback, work coordination, knowledge sharing, and support for team delivery.
* Communicate technical information, delivery progress, risks, decisions, and issues clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, delivery priorities, and enterprise constraints while maintaining solution quality.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve application design, development efficiency, automation, scalability, maintainability, and responsible use of technology resources.
* Manage time and priorities across team leadership, requirements analysis, development, testing, issue resolution, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery commitments.
